description: This file is a Lua script that performs extensive testing of bitwise operations, including basic operators, string coercions, boundary cases, and custom implementations of bitwise functions. It also tests a custom 'bit32' library implementation, verifying correctness across a broad range of inputs and edge cases.

methods.name: bit.bnot
methods.description: Bitwise NOT operation, implemented as '~a & 0xFFFFFFFF' to simulate 32-bit behavior.

methods.name: bit.band
methods.description: Bitwise AND operation, supporting multiple arguments, with masking for 32-bit integers.

methods.name: bit.bor
methods.description: Bitwise OR operation, supporting multiple arguments, with logical OR and masking.

methods.name: bit.bxor
methods.description: Bitwise XOR operation supporting multiple arguments with masking.

methods.name: bit.btest
methods.description: Tests if the bitwise AND of arguments is non-zero.

methods.name: bit.lshift
methods.description: Logical left shift, masking input to 32 bits before shifting.

methods.name: bit.rshift
methods.description: Logical right shift, masking input to 32 bits.

methods.name: bit.arshift
methods.description: Arithmetic right shift, preserving sign bit in a 32-bit context.

methods.name: bit.lrotate
methods.description: Left rotate bits by specified amount within 32 bits.

methods.name: bit.rrotate
methods.description: Right rotate bits by specified amount within 32 bits.

methods.name: bit.extract
methods.description: Extract bits from a specified position and width from an integer.

methods.name: bit.replace
methods.description: Replace bits at a specified position and width with a new value.
